summary: Full backend + frontend E2E verification of the new Solar EPC Dynamic Brand & Price Catalog and related changes. Backend pytest suite (9 tests, 100% pass): public /components + /brands (18 active seeded, category filter works), manage endpoint scoping (admin sees all >=18, vendor scoped to created_by, customer 403), full vendor CRUD (create→update rate→toggle status→delete), customer cannot POST /brands (403), BOQ override changes total (baseline standard ₹2,73,021 → module=Waaree ₹2,96,009) and rate on the module row is replaced with brand rate, and super_admin can delete a vendor-created brand. Frontend E2E via Playwright on the deployed preview: (1) /solar public estimator — expanded brand-select, chose Waaree TOPCon Bifacial module → BOQ module row brand became 'Waaree TOPCon Bifacial' and total flipped from ₹2,73,021 to ₹2,96,009; selecting Growatt inverter → inverter row brand became 'Growatt'. (2) Admin login (abbhuadaya@gmail.com) → Administration → Solar Brands tab renders brands-table with 18 rows; added 'QA Test Inverter' @₹5,555, edited to ₹6,666 (row shows ₹6,666), toggled to 'hidden', deleted via window.confirm — row removed. (3) Vendor (vendor@buildecogroup.com) → Solar Brands nav renders SolarBrandsManager scope=vendor with 0 brands (isolation confirmed — admin's 18 seeded brands NOT visible); vendor added 'Vendor QA Battery' @₹30,000 and deleted it. (4) Login page — 5 rapid clicks on data-testid='login-title' did NOT auto-login (URL stayed on /login) — hardcoded triple-click hack confirmed removed. Normal email/password login for admin and vendor still works. Freelancer profession dashboard: skipped (no freelancer test credentials provided).

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to come from a shadcn/ui Select portal being rendered around native <option> children. Cosmetic hydration warning, does not break functionality but should be cleaned up to keep the console warning-free.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggered on /solar EPC configurator — likely a stray span inside a native <select>/<option> in SolarEstimator.jsx or a wrapping shadcn Select mis-portal. Cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: solar_epc.py — _seed_brands() checks count > 0 before seeding, good idempotency. But if all admin-seeded brands are deleted the seeder will not re-run. Acceptable but worth documenting.

solar_epc.py:_can_manage only allows super_admin and vendor, matching the spec. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE endpoints correctly re-check ownership via _get_owned_brand except create — 403 semantics verified in tests.
SolarBrandsManager.jsx uses window.confirm for delete — matches the spec but not accessible; consider a shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with other destructive actions in the app.
SolarEstimator brand-select is a native <details>/<summary> collapsible with native <select> elements — accessible and testable, no changes needed.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via /lib/api — no hardcoded URLs found in modified files. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (public brand-select, admin CRUD, vendor CRUD+isolation, login auto-login removed)
